name: Dilip Buildcon Ltd
title: Dilip Buildcon Ltd - 540047 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 standalone revenue fell 22% to INR7,005 crore while mgmt guides FY27 revenue up 30-40% on a INR28,000 crore order book; mining and InvIT pivot is the story, EPC margins under inflation pressure.

triggers.label: Mining FY29 target 57 MT coal
triggers.quote: we remain committed to achieving our annual coal production of around 57 million metric tons by FY29

triggers.label: FY27 revenue +30-40%, debt cut INR600-800 cr
triggers.quote: we mentioned it will be a 30% to 40% growth from this number

triggers.label: Siarmal stock 6 MT at site
triggers.quote: we have about 6 million metric tons of stock, which is lying at site because of delayed evacuation by the government

triggers.label: Receivables up on INR400 cr JJM
triggers.quote: the increase in receivable from FY25 to '26 is mainly on account of this INR400 crores receivable from the Jal Jeevan Mission projects

triggers.label: Raw-material inflation not fully passed through
triggers.quote: So it's not completely passed through, and we will be facing those challenges as well as will be the rest of the industry

guidance.quote: we mentioned it will be a 30% to 40% growth from this number
we are targeting that same 11%, 12% EBITDA that we have mentioned
we are also targeting about INR10,000 crores, INR12,000 crores of new order inflow to come in this financial year
We anticipate somewhere between INR600 crores to INR800 crores of debt will be reduced in this financial year

guidance.value: around 57 million metric tons by FY29
guidance.quote: we remain committed to achieving our annual coal production of around 57 million metric tons by FY29
our agenda is to be a net debt-free balance sheet by FY28
we expect revenue to increase to about INR2,500 crores or so in FY27
